prompts.name: first-real-layout
prompts.prompt: We have two apps (web and api) and three environments (dev, staging, prod). All three environments are in the same cluster for now, but prod will move to its own cluster soon. How should I lay out my ConfigHub Spaces?

prompts.name: suffix-naming-migration
prompts.prompt: I already have a Space called `web` with Units named `web-dev`, `web-staging`, `web-prod`. Is that OK or should I restructure?

prompts.name: multi-region
prompts.prompt: We're going live in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 simultaneously for prod. Staging and dev are single-region. How do I model this?
